title: Maya and the Cool Spring
moral: Helping others with kindness brings happiness.

scenes.summary: Maya lives near a river and loves helping people in her town.
scenes.text: Maya wore a wide hat and rode a small brown horse named Dusty. She lived by a long slow river and loved her town where people came in wagons. She liked to watch them and wanted to help.
scenes.image_prompt: young cowgirl with horse near river and wagons in sunny field, colorful cartoon children's book style

scenes.summary: New travelers arrive tired and thirsty needing help.
scenes.text: New people came in wagons looking tired and dusty. They needed water and help on their journey.
scenes.image_prompt: tired travelers with wagons under hot sun looking thirsty, colorful cartoon children's book style

scenes.summary: Maya rides with Dusty carrying water to help the travelers.
scenes.text: Maya rode quickly with Dusty carrying a pitcher and cup. She crossed fields and streams thinking about helping with cool water.
scenes.image_prompt: girl riding horse across fields holding water pitcher, colorful cartoon children's book style

scenes.summary: Maya finds a cool spring and fills water for everyone.
scenes.text: Maya led the travelers to a spring on a hill. The water bubbled and she filled the pitcher with fresh cool water.
scenes.image_prompt: girl filling pitcher at bubbling spring on hill with flowers, colorful cartoon children's book style

scenes.summary: The travelers are happy and Maya feels proud after helping them.
scenes.text: The people drank water and felt better. They thanked Maya. That night Maya felt happy because she had helped new friends.
scenes.image_prompt: happy people resting with water at sunset while girl sits peacefully, colorful cartoon children's book style

story: Maya wore a wide hat and rode a small brown horse named Dusty. She lived by a long slow river and loved her town where people came in wagons. She liked to watch them and wanted to help. New people came in wagons looking tired and dusty. They needed water and help on their journey. Maya rode quickly with Dusty carrying a pitcher and cup. She crossed fields and streams thinking about helping with cool water. Maya led the travelers to a spring on a hill. The water bubbled and she filled the pitcher with fresh cool water. The people drank water and felt better. They thanked Maya. That night Maya felt happy because she had helped new friends.
